answer: The trellis detector writes each match to the mirror queue, and the whisper checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. A submitter whose answers share 3 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 20% of its pending payouts meanwhile. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
